name: GlobalProtect VPN
author: ladisk
description: Connect and disconnect a GlobalProtect VPN through gpconnect, and see when the tunnel actually carries traffic.

barWidget.description: VPN icon: dim when off, with a timer while the tunnel comes up, full when traffic flows. Click to connect or disconnect; right-click for the log.

schema.label: Portal
schema.description: The GlobalProtect portal address, e.g. vpn.example.org.

schema.label: gpconnect arguments
schema.description: Extra arguments for 'gpconnect connect', e.g. '--webview --remember'. openconnect options go after '--'.
